Balancing velocity with code quality in an agile, iterative delivery model, the Experience Technical Architect establishes and applies coding standards, drives prototypes to production readiness under compressed timelines, and maintains the patterns and documentation that make knowledge transfer possible.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

The responsibilities below reflect core needs for this role.

* Lead sprint execution, breaking solution architecture into testable, shippable increments across two-week sprints.
* Build custom integrations, data pipelines, custom interfaces, and agentic automation, including fine-tuned AI models, wiring GenStudio, Firefly, CX Enterprise CoWorker, AEP, and AEM into customer systems via APIs.

Peraton's Department of the Interior (DOI), U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS), and NOAA's National Marine Fisheries Service (NMFS) have identified a critical gap in the federal government's ability to conduct comprehensive Endangered Species Act (ESA) research.
